name: Slim recycling bin, 23 gal, bottles and cans
anchor_point: middle of the rim on a long side
src: empty mass about 3.7 kg for a 23-gallon slim bin, from memory; a light load of bottles and cans assumed; rim lip about 3 cm. Weigh it and state the mass if it matters: the catalogue's strongest gripper is rated 5 kg
notes: Lifted by the rim lip: hooked, not pinched, so the force band's low end is zero and the Payload check covers the weight. A person lifts it with two hands; one gripper under the rim is assumed to hold it level enough to carry. No simulator model yet.
